networks.name: pasar
networks.description: Tell me what you are hungry for. I ask the warung sites for menus and prices, compare them, and hand your order to the warung you pick.
sample_queries: I want something spicy under Rp20.000 near Kemang. What can I get?
Bandingkan harga nasi goreng dan bakmi di warung yang ada.
Which warung has iced tea, and how much is it?
Order 2 nasi goreng for pickup from Warung Bu Sri.
Can you pay for my order and track the delivery driver?

peer_policy.note: Pasar calls only the warung sites in allowed_peers, after the buyer agrees.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
